title: Study to Assess the Effect of Fixed Dose Combination (FDC) Laroprovstat/Rosuvastatin on Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events in Patients Hospitalised With Acute Myocardial Infarction (reAZURE-AMI)
official: A Phase III Prospective, Randomised, Open Label, Blinded Endpoint (PROBE) Study to Assess the Effect of Fixed Dose Combination Laroprovstat/Rosuvastatin on Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events in Patients Hospitalised With Acute Myocardial Infarction
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the effect of FDC laroprovstat/rosuvastatin administered once daily orally versus usual care lipid-lowering therapy (LLT) on reducing the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE-PLUS) in patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participant must be ≥18 years of age
* Participants hospitalised with a primary diagnosis of acute spontaneous MI
* A blood sample collected during hospitalization for the heart attack, before or shortly after starting or changing cholesterol-lowering treatment, must show a LDL cholesterol level that meets the study requirements based on treatment status, along with at least one additional risk factor.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participants requiring invasive hemodynamic and/or vasopressor/inotropic support at the time of screening.
* Uncontrolled severe hypertension
* Uncontrolled T2DM
* Inadequately treated hypothyroidism
